notes.title: * Patch 1 *
notes.content:
*Patch 1*

- Indoor improved Dungeon Maps
- Outdoor improved Maps
- Moving Block inside Savoca Prison
- Balanced difficulty level
- No death in water/heights
- Quests and Sidequests points of interest on maps
- Stamina bar
- minor glitches/bugs fixed

notes.title: *HotFix 1*
notes.content:
Major bugs fixed in this [b]HotFix 1[/b]

-Galleon , red tentacle 
-Abandoned mine, missing stone 
-Sewers, lever not working
-Rodia Town, blocked behind the girl
-Savoca Prison invisible walls on cells with skeletons
-Sewers invisible wall
-Circus, end game chest
-Savoca Prison blocking torch statues
-Few not working collisions

We are working on :
- Heart slots reset, dindis reset, globes reset. This doesnt compromise the overall game progress.
- Minor glitches
- Maps
- Input lag in some configurations
- Resolution selection option
- Vsync options
- Right mouse button - roll not working 

Thanks for your precious feedback and for playing the game !
